title: Passaging cancer organoid cultures
author: Hazel Rogers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfe3jjgn

steps.title: Detach BME2 drops
steps.instruction: Detach BME2 drops from the plate using a P1000 pipette or a cell-scraper (recommended for large numbers of plates).

steps.title: Dissociate organoids from BME2
steps.instruction: Dissociate organoids from BME2 by pipetting the suspension up and down multiple times, then transfer to an appropriate size tube using a P1000 pipette or 10 mL stripette.

steps.title: Collect remaining organoids
steps.instruction: Wash wells with TrypLE (approximately 1 mL per well of a 6 well plate) to collect any remaining organoids and add them to the collection tube.

steps.title: Incubate and monitor dissociation
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 37 °C and monitor under a microscope to assess dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Check suspension after 5 minutes and then as required.
Use a P1000 to pipette the cell suspension up and down to assist dissociation.
Stop incubation when organoids have broken down into small clumps of cells, avoiding breakdown to single cells.

steps.title: Centrifuge organoids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 800 x g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant and resuspend
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant to leave the organoid cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: If the suspension does not pellet or a grey haze (residual BME2) remains above the pellet, aspirate as much supernatant as possible, re-suspend in ice cold PBS, and repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in 80% BME2
steps.instruction: Re-suspend the pellet in the appropriate amount of 80% BME2 (200 µL per well of a 6 well plate).

substeps.instruction: Start by re-suspending the pellet in a small volume to break it down, then add additional BME2 to reach the required volume.
Dispense BME2 as quickly as possible to prevent setting at room temperature; a cool block may be used.

steps.title: Plate organoid suspension
steps.instruction: Using a P200 pipette, dispense a total of 200 µL organoid/BME2 suspension per well of a 6 well plate as 10 µL - 15 µL droplets.

steps.title: Set BME2
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a 37 °C incubator (5% CO2) for 15-30 minutes to allow the BME2 to set.

steps.title: Add media and maintain
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of appropriate organoid media per well of a 6 well plate and return to the incubator.

substeps.instruction: Change media twice a week until ready to passage.

steps.title: Prepare for next passage
steps.instruction: Aspirate media from wells and add 1 mL or 2 mL TrypLE to each well.

substeps.instruction: If BME2 droplets are detached/floating, if there are many cells/organoids floating in media, or if many fibroblasts are attached to the plate, collect organoids and media in a tube and centrifuge to pellet before adding TrypLE.
